entities.summary: Jeffrey Craig Fenholt was an American musician, singer and actor best known for his performance as the title character in the original Broadway theatre production of Jesus Christ Superstar and for his appearance on the cover of Time. In later years, Fenholt gained recognition as a Christian evangelist and singer, as well as controversy over his involvement with the British heavy metal band Black Sabbath.
